thread:
claire-finance: FYI invoice from Anton / Alpine Integrations billed to Redwood EU S.à r.l. Invoice shows 12% withholding and no VAT ID. Vendor also asked if Redwood can gross-up. Holding for documentation.

oscar-legal: Who's the billed legal entity exactly? LU vs US changes the treaty/tax treatment.

claire-finance: Billed to Redwood EU S.à r.l. (Lux). PO #7890 covers the SOW.

anton-vendor: Hi Claire – Anton from Alpine. Our Swiss advisor suggested 12% WHT when invoicing LU. We can send a CFR and either a net invoice with WHT or reissue grossed-up. Which helps you?

apac-payments: Reminder: we only process payment once we have required tax docs and vendor bank details. Gross-up impacts GL coding and budget.

oscar-legal: Please ask for Certificate of Fiscal Residence (CFR) and vendor tax registration number. W-8/W-9 are US-only so they don't apply here.

claire-finance: Requested CFR + updated invoice that shows gross amount, WHT line, net due, vendor tax number, and bank details. Marking payment as "on hold" until items received.

anton-vendor: Sent CFR and invoice v2 to finance@redwood.com (attached). Invoice v2: "Fees 40,000 EUR - Withholding 4,800 EUR (12%) - Net due 35,200 EUR". Also a line: "Vendor requests gross-up to avoid net reduction".

oscar-legal: Thanks. I'll review LuxembourgSwitzerland DTA — some service categories are exempt or subject to relief; might require Luxembourg tax authority clearance to apply reduced rate at source.

apac-payments: If vendor requests gross-up we need PO amendment + spend approval. Finance: estimate incremental cost and tag for approval.

claire-finance: Noted. I'll calculate gross-up delta and open PO amendment if vendor insists. If treaty relief confirmed, we can apply reduced/zero WHT at source (with CFR + any LU clearance).

tax-bot: Thread note: For non-US vendors invoicing EU entities: CFR required; check local DTA; W-8/W-9 not applicable. Add to docs: CFR, updated invoice, vendor tax id, bank details, legal confirmation.

oscar-legal: Quick update: preliminary read suggests business profits taxed in resident state unless PE in LU; I'll confirm EOD whether we can zero-rate. If not, we'll withhold and provide vendor with documentation for credit/refund.

claire-finance: Thanks. Holding payment until legal confirms or vendor agrees to gross-up and PO amendment completes. Will follow up with @anton-vendor when we have next step. :handshake:
